newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - July 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - July 2.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Wednesday's Daily Variety:
* Viacom Inc's troubled Blockbuster video chain expects to report a 76 percent drop in operating profit to as low as $40 million for the second quarter.
* Ridley Scott has a deal to direct Warner Bros.' "I am Legend," and Arnold Schwarzenegger is said to be in the process of sealing his contract on the project.
* The Academy Awards is expected to return to the L.A. County Music Center's Dorothy Chandler Pavilion in 1999.
* United Artists President Lindsay Doran has paid $1.25 million for the screen rights to "Cold Mountain," the debut novel by Charles Frazier.
* Writers earned a record $653 million in 1996, an increase of 12 percent over the prior year, according to the latest report of the Writers Guild of America.
* EMI Group acquired a 50 percent stake in the publishing company from Berry Gordy Jr. for $132 million.
